5 hobbies that will make you
a noticeably different person

rock climbing

try indoor climbing once a week. every route is a small fear you choose to face, and after a month you'll notice you hesitate less in ordinary life too.

volunteering

give two hours a week to a cause you care about. helping people who need it changes how you see your own problems, and it fills your week with real purpose.

learning to sew

learn to fix and make your own clothes. making things with your hands teaches patience, and wearing something you made gives you a quiet kind of pride.

daily curiosity

spend 5 minutes a day learning something new: a myth, a planet, a famous painter. after a few months you notice you talk, think and even listen differently.
slides.texte_sophia:
daily curiosity

i spend 5 minutes a day learning something new now: a myth, a planet, a painter. it's one short lesson in the Sophia app, and after a few months i talk and think differently.

slides.texte_overlay:
running at dawn

run three mornings a week before the world wakes up. the quiet streets and the small win before breakfast quietly change the way you carry yourself all day long.
